name: Control corrosive liquids
description: Provide safe storage, labeling, transfer methods, and spill containment for corrosive liquids.

name: Monitor hazardous substance exposure
description: Ensure exposure levels to hazardous substances are monitored and within legal limits, supported by SDS availability.

name: Control air pollution, noise, and vibration
description: Install engineering controls, monitor environmental conditions, and provide hearing conservation programs.

name: Major hazard installation compliance
description: Conduct hazard identification and risk assessments, notify the Authority, and implement an emergency response plan.

name: Redeployment on medical advice
description: Establish policies for alternative work assignments when medical evaluations indicate risk.

name: Implement permit-to-work system
description: Use formal permit-to-work systems for hazardous tasks such as confined space entry and hot work.

name: Restrict hazardous work for under-18s
description: Verify worker age and prevent those under eighteen from hazardous processes.

name: Supervise apprentices and learners
description: Assign competent supervisors and provide structured training for apprentices and indentured learners.

name: Train and supervise inexperienced workers
description: Conduct induction training and ongoing supervision for inexperienced staff to reduce risks.

name: Safe meals in dangerous trades
description: Provide safe eating facilities away from hazardous areas, with strict hygiene measures.

name: Provide protective clothing and equipment
description: Supply and enforce the use of protective clothing and PPE suitable for identified risks.

name: Eye protection in hazardous processes
description: Mandate protective goggles, shields, or helmets in welding, grinding, and chemical processes.

name: Medical surveillance program
description: Implement periodic medical examinations, health records, and fitness-for-work assessments.

name: Supply safe drinking water
description: Provide sufficient potable drinking water at workplaces, properly marked and regularly tested.

name: Provide washing facilities
description: Install adequate washing facilities including basins, soap, and where necessary showers, separated by gender.

name: Provide clothing accommodation
description: Ensure adequate lockers or rooms for storage of clothing, segregating clean from contaminated garments.

name: Facilities for sitting
description: Provide suitable seats and rest areas for workers where standing is not continuous or required.

name: Provide first-aid facilities
description: Maintain first-aid kits and trained first aiders; larger workplaces must provide a sick bay or treatment room.

name: Separate workplace registration
description: Register separate parts of a building as individual workplaces where applicable.

name: Register and inspect steam boilers
description: Ensure steam boilers are registered, periodically inspected, and fitted with pressure relief devices.

name: Register and inspect hoists and lifts
description: All hoists and lifts must be registered, regularly tested, and maintained for safety.

name: Safety of platforms over water
description: Provide guard rails, life jackets, and rescue equipment for platforms or structures erected over water.

name: Enable inspector powers
description: Allow occupational safety and health officers full access to workplaces for inspections and investigations.

name: Allow officers to conduct proceedings
description: Support officers in legal proceedings relating to occupational health and safety compliance.

name: Sampling for safety
description: Permit occupational safety officers to collect environmental and material samples for testing.

name: Imminent danger response
description: Implement procedures to immediately address hazards that present imminent danger.

name: Comply with improvement notices
description: Take corrective actions within specified timelines when improvement notices are issued.

name: Comply with prohibition notices
description: Stop work and implement corrective measures when prohibition notices are served.

name: Redress and appeal procedure
description: Establish internal procedures for appealing or seeking redress against notices issued by officers.

name: Maintain prohibition and improvement notice compliance
description: Track, document, and ensure full compliance with enforcement notices.

name: Confidentiality of complaints
description: Ensure safety officers do not disclose information or the identity of complainants.

name: Protection from personal liability
description: Ensure that officers acting in good faith within their legal powers are protected from personal liability.

name: Authority liability for damages
description: The Authority is liable for damages arising from its officers’ lawful actions, ensuring accountability.
